method: Direct object IDs and aliases are checked against Forge registry and fluid snapshots. A sourcePlaceholder comes from the original quest file. A poolContainsMissingEntry flags a possible draw. Reported task types, OR alternatives and ore dictionary keys do not establish that a whole quest is blocked. Dimension travel entries require independent provider checks. Metadata and recipe attainability were not tested.
